turns.q: Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
turns.replyTail:
· AI

SweetBot · AI says:

Yes, you can request to cancel an order after placing it, but approval depends on the order status when we process your request.

If the order has not been shipped yet at the time we reply, it can be canceled.
If it has already shipped, we’ll try to intercept it, but success is not guaranteed; otherwise, you may need to return or refuse the package instead.

Address/consignee: Once an order is shipped, we cannot change the address or receiver’s name. You’d need to pick up the item at the original address or have someone else pick it up for you.
Items/quantities & shipping time: After shipment, item quantities/SKUs and shipping time cannot be changed.
Cancellation after shipment: In rare cases, we may intercept a shipped order and cancel it, but the chance is slim; if interception fails, you can refuse delivery or arrange a return instead.
Extra fees: Changing a shipping address after shipment, or requesting special handling (like a signature), may incur additional courier fees.

So, if your order has already shipped, most details (address, items, schedule) generally cannot be changed; we may only be able to attempt interception or handle it via refusal/return, sometimes with extra fees involved.
